metadata.note: VM test for package_policy.conflicts. A minimal bootable system that declares systemd-resolvconf. The guest then reproduces the 2026-09-20 MSI GE63 failure by removing it and installing openresolv instead: both provide `resolvconf`, so pacman refuses any transaction holding the two (`:: openresolv and systemd-resolvconf are in conflict`) and the whole `pacman -S` fails. Neither package names the other — the conflict is only visible through the shared provide, which is why dasik probes with `pacman -Sp` instead of reading metadata. build_failure is warn-and-continue so the blocked apply still exits 0, exactly as it did on the GE63. NOT for real hardware.
